verdict.summary: The frozen two-file correction satisfies the stated acceptance contract. The exported transition-size helper validates both masks and the gap, preserves identical-mask zero cost and SIC1 sizing rules, and is used by the real simulation transition path while encoder sizing remains independent. The isolated mutant test now alters the shared runtime predictor and is correctly expected to fail runtime/encoder agreement. The boolean-only corner count remains behaviorally equivalent without using the rejected Boolean builtin callback. No material logic or security issues were found in the diff.
